The response should not repeat any word more than 4 times. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a medieval king turning his empire's aesthetic into a proto-vaporwaveassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Reginald III stands tall, its stone walls bearing the weight of centuries. But amidst the grandeur, a subtle yet striking transformation takes place. The once-majestic banners now flutter with a peculiar, pastel-hued sheen. The king's heralds, clad in ornate armor, now wear garish, neon-colored tabards.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Reginald III, resplendent in his finery, sits upon his throne. His advisors, a motley crew of courtiers and knights, gather around him. The air is thick with the scent of incense and the soft hum of... something.

REGINALD
( stroking his beard )
My friends, I have a vision. A vision of a new era for our great empire. An era of... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...futurism.

ADVISOR 1
(nervously)
Futurism, Your Majesty?

REGINALD
(nodding)
Yes. We shall incorporate the finest elements of... (he consults a parchment)...Japantown, 1985.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The castle's courtyard is transformed into a surreal landscape. Water features, once tranquil and serene, now bubble and churn with a mesmerizing, iridescent glow. The sound of distant, distorted synths wafts through the air.

REGINALD
( gesturing to the courtyard )
Behold! Our new aesthetic. A fusion of medieval grandeur and... (he smiles)...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors exchange bewildered glances. One of them, a stout knight, speaks up.

KNIGHT
( scratching his head )
But, Your Majesty, what of our enemies? Shall we not, ah, dress them in... (he gestures to the king's attire)...such finery?

REGINALD
(laughing)
Ah, my dear knight, we shall not be bound by the conventions of the past. We shall... (he pauses, a mischievous glint in his eye)...recontextualize the very fabric of reality.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE WALLS - DAY

The castle walls, once imposing and rugged, now display a dizzying array of neon-lit, pixelated patterns. The king's heralds, still clad in their garish tabards, march along the walls, their footsteps echoing through the air.

REGINALD
( standing atop the castle walls )
Behold, my friends! Our empire shall be a beacon of... (he smiles)...futuristic flair.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans across the castle, now a swirling vortex of color and light. The sound of distant synths and the hum of... something... fill the air.

REGINALD
( voiceover )
In a world where the boundaries between past and present are blurred, our empire shall reign supreme. For in the realm of vaporwave, the only constant is... (he pauses, a sly smile spreading across his face)...the future.
